sentences.en: Biff's carpet was torn.
sentences.zh: Biff 地毯是 torn。

sentences.en: It had a big hole in it.
sentences.zh: 它有一个大的洞在……里它。

sentences.en: Biff showed Dad but he said, "We can't afford a new one.
sentences.zh: Biff 展示爸爸但是他说， 我们不能支付得起一个新的一。

sentences.en: Sorry, Biff."
sentences.zh: 对不起， Biff。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip were shopping with Dad.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 是商店和……一起爸爸。

sentences.en: Dad wanted to buy a bookcase for Kipper's room.
sentences.zh: 爸爸想要到买一个书架为了 Kipper 房间。

sentences.en: They saw one outside the junk shop.
sentences.zh: 他们看见一外面这垃圾商店。

sentences.en: "I'll get this for Kipper," said Dad.
sentences.zh: Kipper， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: Biff found an old carpet in the back of the shop.
sentences.zh: Biff 找到一个旧的地毯在……里这回来的这商店。

sentences.en: "This would do for my room," she said.
sentences.zh: 这个会做为了我的房间， 她说。

sentences.en: She asked Dad if she could have it.
sentences.zh: 她问爸爸如果她能有它。

sentences.en: Dad looked at the old carpet.
sentences.zh: 爸爸看在这旧的地毯。

sentences.en: "You don't want that thing," he said.
sentences.zh: 你不想要那个东西， 他说。

sentences.en: "It's old and dirty."
sentences.zh: 它是旧的和脏的。

sentences.en: "But I like it," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "Please may I have it?"
sentences.zh: 我有它？

sentences.en: So Dad said, "Yes, as long as it doesn't cost too much."
sentences.zh: 爸爸说， 是， 像长的像它不花费也许多。

sentences.en: Biff beat the carpet.
sentences.zh: Biff 击打这地毯。

sentences.en: It was full of dust and dirt.
sentences.zh: 它是满的的灰尘和尘垢。

sentences.en: "I didn't think a carpet could be so dusty," she said.
sentences.zh: 我没有想一个地毯能是所以灰尘覆盖的， 她说。

sentences.en: "I wonder who had it last.
sentences.zh: 我惊奇谁有它最后的。

sentences.en: Someone who didn't wipe their feet!"
sentences.zh: 某人谁没有擦他们的脚！

sentences.en: Biff and Mum gave the carpet a shampoo.
sentences.zh: Biff 和妈妈给这地毯一个洗发剂。

sentences.en: "I don't think it has ever had a shampoo before," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我不想它有在任何时候有一个洗发剂在……之前， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "It looks better already."
sentences.zh: 它看更好的已经。

sentences.en: The carpet looked beautiful.
sentences.zh: 这地毯看美丽的。

sentences.en: "It is a nice carpet," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 它是一个好的地毯， 说 Biff， 我告诉你所以！ 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "I told you so.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你所以， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: It looks quite old, so maybe it's worth a lot of money."
sentences.zh: 它看相当旧的， 所以也许它是值某金额一个许多的钱。

sentences.en: Biff was in her bedroom reading a book.
sentences.zh: Biff 是在……里她卧室读一个书。

sentences.en: Kipper came in and they sat on Biff's new carpet.
sentences.zh: Kipper 来在……里和他们坐在……上 Biff 新的地毯。

sentences.en: Kipper was learning to read and he wanted to read to Biff.
sentences.zh: Kipper 是学习到读和他想要到读到 Biff。

sentences.en: Suddenly, the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 突然地这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: Another adventure had begun.
sentences.zh: 另一个冒险有开始。

sentences.en: This time Biff and Kipper were on a flying carpet.
sentences.zh: 这个时间 Biff 和 Kipper 是在……上一个飞地毯。

sentences.en: "This is a new kind of adventure," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 这个是一个新的友善的的冒险， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "The carpet is coming with us," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 这地毯是来和……一起我们。

sentences.en: The carpet went very fast.
sentences.zh: 这地毯去非常快的。

sentences.en: "Oh, help," Said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 帮助！ 哦帮助， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: "I hope we don't fall off."
sentences.zh: 我希望我们不落下离开。

sentences.en: The carpet flew on and on.
sentences.zh: 这地毯飞在……上和在……上。

sentences.en: It flew over deserts and mountains.
sentences.zh: 它飞在……上方应得的奖赏和山。

sentences.en: "I wonder where we're going!" Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我惊奇哪里我们是去！ 说 Biff。 哇！

sentences.en: At last, the carpet slowed down.
sentences.zh: 在最后的， 这地毯慢的向下。

sentences.en: Biff and Kipper looked over the side.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Kipper 看在……上方这私德。

sentences.en: The carpet was flying over a town.
sentences.zh: 这地毯是飞在……上方一个城镇。

sentences.en: "I've never seen a town like this one," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我已经从不看见一个城镇喜欢这个一， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "I wonder if we're going to land."
sentences.zh: 我惊奇如果我们是去到陆地。

sentences.en: But the carpet didn't land.
sentences.zh: 但是这地毯没有陆地。

sentences.en: Instead it went slower and slower.
sentences.zh: 作为替代它去慢的和慢的。

sentences.en: Then it stopped by a window at the top of a tower.
sentences.zh: 然后它停由一个窗户在这顶的一个塔。

sentences.en: "I wonder why we've stopped here," said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 我惊奇为什么我们已经停这里， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: Said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 哦帮助， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: Biff and Kipper looked through the window.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Kipper 看穿过这窗户。

sentences.en: They saw a little boy.
sentences.zh: 他们看见一个小的男孩。

sentences.en: He was crying and he looked very unhappy.
sentences.zh: 他是哭和他看非常痛苦的。

sentences.en: "He must be a prisoner," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 他必须是一个犯人， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: Biff and Kipper climbed into the little room.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Kipper 爬进入这小的房间。

sentences.en: When the boy saw them, he jumped up in surprise.
sentences.zh: 当……时这男孩看见他们， 他跳向上在……里意想不到的事物。

sentences.en: "Why are you locked up in this tower?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 为什么是你锁向上在……里这个塔？ 问 Biff。 为什么？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: "What have you done?"
sentences.zh: 什么有你做完？

sentences.en: "I am the real king of this land," Said the boy sadly.
sentences.zh: 他们是看出的这窗户。

sentences.en: "But my wicked uncle locked me in this tower."
sentences.zh: 我是这真的国王的这个陆地， 说这男孩悲伤地， 但是我的恶毒的伯父锁我在……里这个塔。

sentences.en: "When I was king everyone was happy.
sentences.zh: 当……时我是国王每个人是快乐的。

sentences.en: I promised to rule the country wisely and well.
sentences.zh: 我承诺到规则这国家明智地和好。

sentences.en: But my uncle was jealous.
sentences.zh: 但是我的伯父是嫉妒的。

sentences.en: He wanted to be the king, instead.
sentences.zh: 他想要到是这国王， 作为替代。

sentences.en: "One day my uncle and his soldiers attacked the palace.
sentences.zh: 一一天我的伯父和他的士兵攻击这宫。

sentences.en: They captured me and put me in prison.
sentences.zh: 他们俘获我和放我在……里监狱。

sentences.en: My mother escaped.
sentences.zh: 我的妈妈逃跑。

sentences.en: She ran away to the mountains and took her army with her.
sentences.zh: 她跑离开到这山和拿她陆军和……一起她。

sentences.en: "My uncle is a bad man.
sentences.zh: 我的伯父是一个坏的男人。

sentences.en: He is cruel and greedy.
sentences.zh: 他是残忍的和贪食的。

sentences.en: He makes the people pay him money even if they are poor.
sentences.zh: 他做这人们付钱他钱竟然如果他们是贫穷的。

sentences.en: If they can't pay, he puts them in prison.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不能付钱， 他放他们在……里监狱。

sentences.en: Nobody is happy.
sentences.zh: 没有人是快乐的。

sentences.en: "Every day the people ask my mother and her army to attack the city.
sentences.zh: 每个一天这人们问我的妈妈和她陆军到攻击这城市。

sentences.en: She will not give the order to attack because she is afraid my uncle will harm me.
sentences.zh: 她将不给这条理到攻击因为她是害怕的我的伯父将损害我。

sentences.en: I am a hostage in this palace."
sentences.zh: 我是一个人质在……里这个宫。

sentences.en: "Then we must set you free," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 然后我们必须设置你自由的， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "The carpet will take us to your mother."
sentences.zh: 这地毯将拿我们到你的妈妈。

sentences.en: Biff and Kipper helped the boy to climb out of the window.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Kipper 帮助这男孩到爬出的这窗户。

sentences.en: Then they all sat on the carpet.
sentences.zh: 然后他们全部坐在……上这地毯。

sentences.en: "How will we make it fly?" Asked Kipper.
sentences.zh: 如何做我们做它飞？ 问 Kipper。 什么是他们？ 问 Kipper。

sentences.en: "How will it know where to take us?"
sentences.zh: 如何将它知道哪里到拿我们？

sentences.en: "Make a wish," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 做一个希望， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "Then it'll go where we want it to."
sentences.zh: 然后它会去哪里我们想要它到。

sentences.en: They made a wish, and the carpet zoomed off.
sentences.zh: 他们做一个希望， 和这地毯疾行离开。

sentences.en: The carpet sped towards the mountains.
sentences.zh: 这地毯 sped 向这山。

sentences.en: At last it began to slow down.
sentences.zh: 在最后的它开始到慢的向下。

sentences.en: "I hope it knows how to land," said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 我希望它知道如何到陆地， 说 Kipper。 哦帮助， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: "It looks a long way down."
sentences.zh: 它看一个长的方式向下。

sentences.en: The carpet landed safely.
sentences.zh: 这地毯拥有大量土地的平安地。

sentences.en: When the boy's mother saw him, she couldn't believe her eyes.
sentences.zh: 当……时这男孩妈妈看见他， 她不能相信她眼睛。

sentences.en: She looked at the carpet and she looked at Biff and Kipper.
sentences.zh: 她看在这地毯和她看在 Biff 和 Kipper。

sentences.en: "My son is safe," She said.
sentences.zh: Floppy 是安全的。

sentences.en: "Thank you."
sentences.zh: 谢谢你， Gran。

sentences.en: The boy's mother called all her soldiers.
sentences.zh: 这男孩妈妈叫全部她士兵。

sentences.en: She told them her son was free.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他们她儿子是自由的。

sentences.en: "Now he is safe.
sentences.zh: 这相机是安全的。

sentences.en: We can attack the city," She said.
sentences.zh: 现在他是安全的， 我们能攻击这城市， 她说。 Biff， 他说。

sentences.en: "My son will be king again." "Hooray!"
sentences.zh: 我的儿子将是国王再一次。

sentences.en: "Hooray!" shouted the soldiers.
sentences.zh: CRE 好耶！ 喊这士兵。

sentences.en: They came down from the mountains and marched to the city.
sentences.zh: 他们来向下从这山和齐步走到这城市。

sentences.en: There was a big battle.
sentences.zh: 那里是一个大的战斗。

sentences.en: Biff, Kipper and the boy watched the battle from a safe place.
sentences.zh: Biff， Kipper 和这男孩手表这战斗从一个安全的地方。

sentences.en: When the battle was over everyone was pleased that the boy was king again.
sentences.zh: 当……时这战斗是在……上方每个人是请那个这男孩是国王再一次。

sentences.en: But the boy was not pleased.
sentences.zh: 但是这男孩是不请。

sentences.en: "Where is my uncle?" He asked.
sentences.zh: 哪里是我的伯父？ 他问。 他追赶它！

sentences.en: "He must be punished for what he did."
sentences.zh: 他必须是惩罚为了什么他做。

sentences.en: Biff and Kipper saw someone running away.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Kipper 看见某人跑离开。

sentences.en: It was the wicked uncle.
sentences.zh: 它是这恶毒的伯父。

sentences.en: "Oh no!" Said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 哦不！ 哦帮助， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: Said Kipper, "he's getting away.
sentences.zh: Kipper， 他是得到离开。

sentences.en: How can we stop him?"
sentences.zh: 如何能我们停他？

sentences.en: Biff had the magic carpet with her.
sentences.zh: Biff 有这魔法地毯和……一起她。

sentences.en: "I wonder if..?" She thought.
sentences.zh: 我惊奇为什么？ 我惊奇如果。。？ 她想。

sentences.en: Biff made a wish and the magic carpet flew after the wicked uncle.
sentences.zh: Biff 做一个希望和这魔法地毯飞在……之后这恶毒的伯父。

sentences.en: The wicked uncle rode as fast as he could but the carpet was faster.
sentences.zh: 这恶毒的伯父骑像快的像他能但是这地毯是快的。

sentences.en: "Stop him!" Called Biff.
sentences.zh: 如何能我们停他？ Floppy！ 叫 Biff。

sentences.en: The carpet pulled the wicked uncle from his horse.
sentences.zh: 这地毯拉这恶毒的伯父从他的马。

sentences.en: It wrapped itself round him and then it rolled him back to the city.
sentences.zh: 它包它自己圆形的他和然后它使滚动他回来到这城市。

sentences.en: "Help!
sentences.zh: 帮助！

sentences.en: Help!" called the wicked uncle.
sentences.zh: 帮助！ 叫这恶毒的伯父。

sentences.en: "Get this carpet off me!"
sentences.zh: 得到这个地毯离开我！

sentences.en: Biff and Kipper took the wicked uncle to the boy.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Kipper 拿这恶毒的伯父到这男孩。

sentences.en: "Thank you," He said.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你， Gran。 Biff， 他说。

sentences.en: "It's my uncle's turn to go to prison.
sentences.zh: 它是我的伯父转动到去到监狱。

sentences.en: Now I can be a good king and look after my people again."
sentences.zh: 我能是一个好的国王和看在……之后我的人们再一次。

sentences.en: The boy gave Biff and Kipper a present.
sentences.zh: 这男孩给 Biff 和 Kipper 一个礼物。

sentences.en: It was a beautiful toy camel.
sentences.zh: 它是一个美丽的玩具骆驼。

sentences.en: "Thank you," They said.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你， Gran。 不我们！ 他们说。

sentences.en: Suddenly the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 突然地这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: "It's time for us to go," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 它是时间到去。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "But we'll take our carpet if you don't mind."
sentences.zh: Biff， 但是我们会拿我们的地毯如果你不头脑。

sentences.en: The magic key took Biff and Kipper home.
sentences.zh: 这魔法钥匙拿 Biff 和 Kipper 家。

sentences.en: "What an adventure!" Said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 什么一个冒险， 说 Nadim。 哦帮助， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: "Do you think if I wish very hard, the carpet will take me to school each day?" "You'll be lucky!" Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 做你想如果我希望非常困难的， 这地毯将拿我到学校每个一天？ 你会是幸运的！ 说 Biff。 哇！
